encounter.title: EXP-013 debug — Stone Throw (seed 15)
encounter.notes: EXP-013 spike/experiment, NOT accepted design, separate from prologue/Act I content. easy 6x7 seed 15 (11 arrows, N4 E1 S4 W2; initially free N2 E1 S1 W1: ids 0,1 N; 3 E; 8 S; 9 W). One enemy on N (rockthrower, 3 hp, ATTACK IN 5 dmg 1 -- gentle, damage is not the point of this spike) with Stone Throw: THROW IN 3, targetPolicy free-arrow, pin 2 world turns (both TUNING -- first minimal values tried, not a balance decision). Demonstrates: at world turn 3 the ability fires and pins the lowest-id currently free-and-unpinned arrow; a player who was about to tap that exact arrow next must re-read the board and pick a different move for 2 turns, then it opens back up. No Rotate in this debug encounter. See EXP-013-REPORT.md for the exact verified turn sequence, the no-softlock argument, and minDamageToWin results.
